name: Seaside Daisy
desc: Seaside Daisy (Erigeron glaucus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 212 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erigeron glaucus is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae known by the common name seaside fleabane, beach aster, or seaside daisy. It is native to the West Coast of the United States.
